foundation.title: Why Inigo exists
foundation.body:
The world today rarely lets the heart rest on the ground.

We are either pulled upward —
into noise, speed, and constant emotion —

or pushed downward —
into exhaustion and numbness.

Both keep us moving.
Both keep us disconnected.

Inigo creates a different place.

Not above.
Not below.

But on the ground —
where presence carries love
without fear.

whatIsInigo.title: What Inigo is
whatIsInigo.body:
Inigo is a place to put down time.

Not to escape life,
but to meet it fully —
as it is.

You choose a moment.
You stay with it.
You let time soften.

What you're doing doesn't matter.

Sitting quietly.
Walking without destination.
Reading.
Working with attention.
Moving your body.
Touching the earth.
Caring for another.

If you are here —
it counts.

Sit.

quietEvents.title: Quiet events
quietEvents.body:
A time is set.
Everyone starts together.

presenceInAction.title: Presence in action
presenceInAction.text:
Presence doesn't belong to one action.

Silence is one way.
So is walking.
Reading a book.
Working in the garden.
Eating.
Being with family.
Being with another heart.

Any moment where you are truly here
can hold the heart on the ground.

We take that responsibility seriously.

Collect only what we need.
Protect what you share.
Be transparent about how everything works.
By using Inigo, you agree to this Privacy Policy.
